Brokers send their toughest risks straight to Rich.

Richard Rooney · Chief Underwriting Officer
35+ years · Property & Inland Marine

For hard-to-place specialty risk, the difference is not a portal or a platform. It is one underwriter with the experience to read a risk correctly and the relationships to find it a home. That underwriter is Rich.

  • Pre-underwritten before it movesEvery submission is read by Rich before it ever reaches a market. Thirty-five years of judgment applied up front, so it lands right the first time.

  • He picks up the phoneWhen a placement needs a push, Rich calls the decision-maker directly, the person who can actually say yes. That access is what turns a maybe into a bound account.
  • A track record of profitable growthAcross several major carriers and MGAs, Rich has consistently reduced loss ratios while increasing written premium. He underwrites for profit and growth, not just volume.
